BiblicalUsage: Mekonah is a town in the land of Judah, named once in the list of places settled after the return from exile. Nehemiah 11:28 places it beside Ziklag, among the villages where the returned families lived.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a town named once matters, because it marks a family that came home.
